note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. THIRTEEN Ag Partners locations come back from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0172401/cash-bids?units=us, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. The site id is a path segment, not a query parameter, and the key goes in an `apikey` HEADER -- see apiKeyEnv below; it is never written into a file or a URL, so it cannot end up in a log line. Found 2026-08-20 from Sig's own DevTools capture on agpartners.net and confirmed against DTN's OpenAPI document at cp-docs.dtn.com/content-packages/api-specs/markets-api/markets-api-1.0.json. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id AND NOT THE NAME: 'Red Wing Grain LLC' is a joint venture's company name rather than a town, and a display name is the thing a vendor re-cases. cashRounding is floor-cent because their cash cell is the arithmetic TRUNCATED to the cent -- measured across 25 live records, floor explains 25 of 25 while round explains only 11 -- so the identity guard stays exact instead of being handed a blunt three-quarter-cent tolerance. Their futures column is quoted in eighths with an apostrophe ("478'6"), which parse.mjs only learned to read on 2026-08-20; before that it returned 478 and threw the eighths away in silence. Ag Partners' own site lists FIFTEEN grain sites; the bid feed carries thirteen. Oshawa (41784 450th Street, St. Peter) posts no bids in the feed and therefore has no source file -- absent is not empty, and a site that does not quote is not a site that quotes zero. Seasonal grain site. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: their page gives a street with no number and the geocoder returns zero matches for it. No number, no coordinate.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
